name: SBDS ribosome maturation factor

function.text: SBDS encodes ribosome maturation protein SBDS. Annotated molecular activities include microtubule binding and rRNA binding. It participates in bone mineralization and leukocyte chemotaxis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Shwachman-Diamond syndrome (autosomal recessive); Shwachman-Diamond syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
